releaseNotes: V977 improves AI Grounding recovery for no-criteria explanations without weakening the semantic evidence gate.
Explicit non-evaluation wording is recognized structurally across EN/KR/JP/CN/DE/ES, while mixed positive claims such as 'appears normal' remain blocked when no condition criteria exist.

Semantic Grounding failures such as condition_criteria, trend_criteria, baseline_criteria, and unsupported missing-data inference now receive one corrective AI retry and are fully revalidated; a second failure remains BLOCKED.

Deterministic Operational/Condition evaluation, V975 status-card UI, AI Data Library, Safe Disconnect, communication, Polling/MAX, PDO/ISDU, Studio Runtime, HMI read-only, and Signal Tower hardware-control paths are unchanged.

en: Improved Grounding recovery for explicit no-criteria / NOT_EVALUATED explanations.
Non-evaluation wording is recognized structurally across supported UI languages; mixed positive condition claims remain blocked.
Semantic Grounding failures receive one corrective retry and are fully revalidated; repeated failures remain BLOCKED.
No change to deterministic evaluation or protected runtime/control paths.
ko: No Criteria / NOT_EVALUATED 설명의 Grounding 회복 경로를 보강했습니다.
지원 언어에서 비판정 문맥을 구조적으로 인식하며, Criteria가 없는데 '정상으로 보임' 같은 실제 Condition 주장은 계속 차단합니다.
condition_criteria 등 Semantic Grounding 실패는 1회 교정 재요청 후 전체 재검증하며, 재실패 시 그대로 BLOCKED 처리합니다.
결정론적 평가 및 보호된 Runtime/제어 경로는 변경하지 않았습니다.
ja: No Criteria / NOT_EVALUATED 説明の Grounding 回復経路を強化しました。
対応言語で非評価の文脈を構造的に認識し、基準がない状態での肯定的な状態判定は引き続き遮断します。
Semantic Grounding エラーは1回だけ修正再要求して再検証し、再度失敗した場合は BLOCKED のままです。
決定論的評価および保護された Runtime/制御経路は変更していません。
zh-CN: 增强了 No Criteria / NOT_EVALUATED 说明的 Grounding 恢复路径。
在支持语言中结构化识别未评估语境；没有标准时的肯定性状态判断仍会被拦截。
Semantic Grounding 失败仅进行一次纠正重试并重新完整验证；再次失败仍保持 BLOCKED。
未修改确定性评估及受保护的 Runtime/控制路径。
de: Der Grounding-Wiederherstellungspfad für No-Criteria-/NOT_EVALUATED-Erklärungen wurde verbessert.
Nichtbewertungs-Kontext wird in den unterstützten Sprachen strukturell erkannt; positive Zustandsaussagen ohne Kriterien bleiben blockiert.
Semantische Grounding-Fehler erhalten genau einen Korrekturversuch und werden vollständig neu validiert; erneutes Scheitern bleibt BLOCKED.
Deterministische Bewertung und geschützte Runtime-/Steuerpfade wurden nicht geändert.
es: Se mejoró la recuperación de Grounding para explicaciones No Criteria / NOT_EVALUATED.
El contexto de no evaluación se reconoce de forma estructural en los idiomas compatibles; las afirmaciones positivas sin criterios siguen bloqueadas.
Los fallos semánticos de Grounding reciben un único reintento correctivo y se vuelven a validar por completo; si falla de nuevo, permanece BLOCKED.
No se modificaron la evaluación determinista ni las rutas protegidas de Runtime/control.
